This parameter is used to explicitly include the issuer identifier of the authorization server in the authorization response of an OAuth authorization flow. The iss parameter serves as an effective countermeasure to "mix-up attacks". ¶ Copyright Notice Copyright (c) 2022 IETF Trust and the persons identified as the document authors.    OAuth Authorization Server Metadata 5.    Informative References Acknowledgements Authors' Addresses 1.
